benchmarks.name: alphaXiv ArXivQA Retrieval
benchmarks.notes: Firecrawl reports 53.3% recall at $0.32/task versus 45.4% for the next best system, plus MRR 0.750, on roughly 200 alphaXiv ArXivQA queries. Human-gated as reported benchmark evidence for literature-search; counts at the reported lane (1.0x) unless a future audit rejects the benchmark source.

benchmarks.name: HumanEval
benchmarks.notes: Python function-completion benchmark (164 problems). Gaia reproduces via an internal CI harness; verified rows carry datasetHash + benchmarkInputHash and count at the verified lane (2.0x). Legacy ci-reproduced and verifier-attested provenance aliases normalize to verified.

benchmarks.name: MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding)
benchmarks.notes: 5-shot MMLU average scores sourced from the HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard snapshot dated 2024-03-01. Human-gated mirrored benchmark evidence counts at the reported lane (1.0x); the legacy mirrored provenance alias normalizes to reported.
